prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production reference sheet for the Toktogi 2D game. Match the already displayed C011 springtail reference in rounded low-poly cartoon forms, clean dark blue-gray edge definition, restrained surface texture, readable four-tone shading, matte natural green/brown palette (the plant must retain its natural color, not springtail white). Off-white background, uniform neutral light, orthographic multi-view panels: top, front, left, right, back, underside/detail, consistently same object, no perspective distortion, no scenery, no shadow crossing panels, no text on object. Labels outside object in English with asset ID. Broad simple forms suitable for editable low-poly Blender geometry. Do not add a springtail character. This is a reference sheet, not a runtime sprite. Subject: B04 Salvinia natans module, exactly TWO opposite oval floating leaves linked at their base to a short stem, plus one finely divided submerged leaf underneath. The underwater branching organ is a submerged LEAF not roots. Selected floating leaves each 10 by 6 mm. Upper surfaces have orderly subtle water-repellent hairs. Do not depict long straight true roots.
style_input_delivery: Reference displayed in conversation; new-image call omitted explicit image-path arguments.
correction: 생성 시트 상면의 수중 잎은 설명용 펼침이다. 모델에서는 잎 쌍 아래로 수중 잎을 배치한다. 털은 확대도처럼 전면을 덮지 않도록 단순화한다.
